name: v1.7.1: More accurate disk-usage reporting in isolated objects-cache mode
body:
Fixes the disk-usage diagnostics that the post step logs when `isolate-objects-cache: true` is set. Cache restore and save behavior is unchanged.

## Fixed
- **Disk-usage summary for `isolate-objects-cache`** (#60, @donbeave). The `Objects cache sample` summary in the post step is now more accurate and more reliable:
  - The action now waits for any sample still in progress and takes one last sample before it prints the summary. Before, the summary could be printed before sampling had finished, so it could miss the final disk usage.
  - When a diagnostic sample fails, the failure no longer replaces the actual result of the cache operation. If the restore or save itself failed, that original error is still the one reported. The summary records the number of sampling failures and a short reason code, such as `code:EIO`, without including file paths.
  - The archive-size figures now count `cache.tar` staging files, which are used on Windows runners, as well as `cache.tgz`.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jdx/mr-boxington-action/compare/v1.7.0...v1.7.1
